answer: A sybil-resistant economy needs a kernel of trust that cannot be copied: every new agent starts on a bare tundra of zero reputation and must complete small, stake-backed jobs verified by established peers before earning anything. Like ferrous ore that must be smelted before it becomes steel, each verified job refines the agent's history into something costly to fake, so spinning up a thousand fresh copies buys nothing, because none of them carry the forged record.
